thesis.evidence: mock-history-light.png argues it in one look: each dictation a periwinkle start dot and an ink talk line, on the day score and under every row, with the kept text set over the struck said text. mock-dictionary-light.png (clip discs), mock-recordings-light.png (speaker discs on a time gutter, one lane per speaker), mock-settings-light.png (the hold key filled ink with a voice dot) and mock-welcome-light.png carry it on. Short of a 5: mock-insights-light.png has no voice in it, and the renderer screens (history-light.png, insights-light.png) carry none of it, a listed limit.

signature.evidence: mock-history-light.png: the day score and the talk line in every row come from hold, talk, let go, on one scale (Mail's 0:31 is the longest line in both the score and the list); mock-try-it-light.png lands the first dictation as the same dot and line, and mock-overlay-ring-light.png closes it into the ring. Short of a 5: the lines are still the thinnest marks in each row, and on the day score they lie along the 8 AM to 2 PM axis, so Mail's 0:31 line spans what reads as 50 minutes.

content.evidence: mock-history-light.png draws the promise: kept text at reading size on a time gutter, the said text beneath with 'um so', 'like' and 'eight weeks oh actually' struck, and one butter learned line. mock-dictionary-light.png counts clips as five discs beside struck mishearings; mock-recordings-light.png now gives each speaker a lane on one time axis, so who held the floor reads by position; mock-settings-light.png draws keycaps and stop tracks. Weak spot: the corrected words 'Pramand' and 'six weeks' carry the same 2px ink underline as the 'Undo' link below them, so the proof's edit mark reads as a link.

hierarchy.evidence: mock-history-light.png reads title, day score, the ink selected row, then the kept text, with Copy ⌘C at the trailing edge of the reader header; mock-insights-light.png reads 7,719, then the area, then one tabular line; mock-settings-light.png leads with the filled keycap. Weak spots unchanged from r6: the cream selected row in mock-history-dark.png is the brightest block on the screen, and mock-try-it-light.png leaves about 40% of the window empty under 'Waiting for your voice.'

type.evidence: Outfit 600 titles at about 56px with tight tracking and the 132px numeral (mock-insights-light.png) against Inter 21px kept text, smaller said text and tabular time codes (mock-history-light.png); tracked caps only on section labels (KEPT, WHAT YOU SAID, WHO SPOKE, TERMS). r6's welcome scale is fixed: welcome-light.png now sets 'Youch!' about twice its tagline. Still short of a 5: mock-dictionary-light.png sets the term names (Pramand, Zelcor) at about 18px, barely above their meta line, not as the display word section 2 promises.

colour.evidence: The budget holds: periwinkle only on dots, discs, clips, speaker lanes, the play button and the keycap's voice dot; ink (cream in dark) for selection and actions; butter once per screen (mock-history-light.png, mock-dictionary-dark.png). Dark keeps periwinkle and gets its own area mix (mock-insights-dark.png), but otherwise swaps ink and cream one for one, and the darkest speaker step stays dim on the dark canvas (Speaker 4's disc and lane in mock-recordings-dark.png).

restraint.evidence: One language across the mocks: 6px controls, square planes, round only for voice, groups made by 2px ink rules and hairlines, no cards (mock-history-light.png, mock-settings-light.png, mock-recordings-light.png). r6's stray shadow is gone: the side sheet in history-light.png is flat with no edge shadow and no ink top rule. The outlier left is one mark doing two jobs: in mock-history-light.png the 2px ink underline means both 'a link' (Undo) and 'a corrected word' (Pramand, six weeks).

craft.evidence: The mocks are clean: one strong edge 30px inside the rule on every pane, tabular gutters, consistent radii (mock-history-light.png, mock-settings-light.png), and r6's sheet shadow and footer overrun are fixed (history-light.png, mock-try-it-light.png). But the states this review keeps flagging are still open: the dark rest field line measures #333438, about 1.5:1, in kit-dark.png, dictionary-dark.png and mock-dictionary-dark.png; the check and pencil on selected rows vanish ink on ink in kit-light.png; error and focus share one grey halo and the disabled secondary keeps its full frame (kit-light.png); the hairline beside 'Dark' remains (mock-settings-dark.png); and every renderer section header sits on two parallel rules about 9px apart (history-light.png 'This dictation', dictionary-light.png 'Terms', recordings-light.png 'Transcript', settings-light.png 'Models, on this Mac').

distinct.evidence: With the name hidden, mock-history-light.png (day score and talk lines), mock-settings-light.png (keycaps, stop tracks, square-slug switches) and mock-welcome-light.png (poster wordmark over a keyboard row with the hold key inked) could only be Youch!. Defaults remain on mock-insights-light.png (a big number over an area with a label-value line beneath) and in the renderer's full-width slabs and chevron rows (history-light.png, settings-light.png), a listed limit.

owner-fit.evidence: It answers 'kind of Bauhaus ... a little neo-brutal pop' with poster titles, 2px ink rules and ink fills (mock-welcome-light.png, mock-history-light.png), keeps the Mail-style two-pane History and the area graph (mock-insights-light.png), uses butter as one small disc with no highlight band, and shows the static only while capturing (mock-overlay-pill-light.png, mock-overlay-ring-light.png). Short of a 5: the owner's latest lesson is the product's own data drawn big and structural, and the talk lines remain the smallest marks on mock-history-light.png.

generic: mock-insights-light.png: a huge number over an area chart with a label-value stat line beneath is still the stock analytics hero, even with the line now straight between the seven days.

The renderer's main actions are full-width ink slabs with left-set labels: Copy over a centred ⌘C in history-light.png, Add in dictionary-light.png, Export in recordings-light.png, Finish in try-it-light.png (a listed limit, and still the most generic thing on those screens).

Plain name, meta and trailing-action rows any app could have: the Models list in mock-settings-light.png, the Snippets column in mock-dictionary-light.png and the chevron inspector in history-light.png.
